set.body:
Objective
Construct RelationSet from identified effects, partitions and neural axes, with composed runwise B = A Y and typed estimability, residual-moment, precision and degrees-of-freedom capabilities.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements REL-01, FND-01, FND-07. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
relational integration; modules/mvpa-fit OneShotDataset/OneShotMvpa; modules/mvpa-dataset; lower fit/readout adapters. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.01, M1.02, M1.04. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Dense and composed readout values agree without requiring eager trial images; lower-level fit does not depend on MVPA.
2. Unavailable residual/df capabilities are a bind-time refusal for methods needing them, not fabricated optional fields.
3. Effect restriction preserves readout/acquisition and fitted-preparation origins plus estimability.
4. One-shot/replay capabilities and owned reader lifetimes are explicit; source/backend choice does not redefine scientific spaces.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
sbt mvpaDatasetJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaDatasetJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M2.01: Build typed partitioned relations and operator-native fMRI evidence adapters
